complete.description: Totals checked only with --complete, for a full content set.

basicRecovery.description: A basic attack's recovery, as a share of the weapon's base cooldown. Sets the Attack Speed ceiling.

abilityCast.description: An ability's cast time unless it states one.

abilityRecovery.description: An ability's recovery unless it states one: about a sword's.

armorRatio.description: Each physical hit loses armorRatio × the target's Armor, as a flat amount.

armorFloor.description: Armor can't take a physical hit below this % of its size. Absent or 0: enough Armor blanks a hit. Ignored when armorK is set.

armorK.description: Armor by the Path of Exile formula: a physical hit deals hit² ÷ (hit + armorK × Armor), so Armor is nearly linear against big hits and never blanks one. Replaces armorRatio and armorFloor when above 0; absent or 0, the flat cut.

taken.description: Bounds on a unit's total damage-taken modifier, in percent.

kind.description: A weapon kind: sets type, cooldown and hands. Any field stated here overrides the kind's.

cooldown.description: The base cooldown, in ticks. Required without a kind.

amount.description: Per hit: a base, plus whatever scaling the weapon states. Nothing scales it by default.

cast.description: Default 0: basic attacks have no wind-up unless the weapon states one.

stacks.description: Intensity: stacks added, scaled only as stated here, plus the applier's boosts that name the status or its tags. Default 1.

duration.description: Default: the status's own. 0 only for an instant lockout.

chance.description: Percent, rolled on the applier's dice. Default: guaranteed.

unarmed.description: The basic attack of a unit with no weapon.

maxEnemies.description: Most living units on the enemy side, summons included.

enrage.description: A fight that runs past `after` ticks: every unit, on both sides, deals pct % more damage with hits and reactions, and pct more again every `every` ticks, so no fight stalls. Absent: fights run to the safety stop.

opening.description: At fight start each action is already partly charged: it's first ready after a share of its cooldown, rolled between min and max on the unit's dice for each action (but see slots). Absent: every action starts a fight on its full cooldown.

slots.description: A party unit's abilities start this many ticks charged, by the order they're slotted in (first, second, third), in place of the roll: the order is the player's to choose. Its basic attack still rolls.

slotShares.description: Step 5g: as slots, but as a share of each ability's own cooldown (0.75 is three quarters charged), so a slow ability's head start is long too. Wins over slots when both are set.

draw.description: Foes pick in proportion to draw, not Aggro. With d how far a unit's Aggro is from `centre`: above it, draw = centre × (k + max × d) ÷ (k + d); below it, centre × (k + d) ÷ (k + max × d). An ordinary unit draws `centre`; none draws more than `max` times that or less than 1 ÷ max; +d and −d cancel. `k` sets how much the first steps count. Absent: picks weighted by Aggro itself.

stagger.description: Copies of the same enemy start a fight this many ticks apart, one after another, so identical foes don't act in lockstep. Absent or 0: they start together.

lostCast.description: An action interrupted in its wind-up, or whose targets are gone when it resolves. retry (the default): no MP, no cooldown, so it can start again at once. cooldown: no MP, but an interrupted action goes on cooldown, as a cast that fizzles for MP does, and one that found no target costs the unit its recovery.

control.description: Step 5i: control resistance on bosses. Absent: none.

ranks.description: Enemies of these ranks resist control.

statuses.description: The control statuses: each one that lands adds a hidden stack (a Chill shatter's Stun included). One that doesn't land (Fizzle, an immunity) adds nothing.

resist.description: From `at` stacks, they land for pct % of their own length, and the battle text says RESISTED.

cap.description: The most stacks. At the cap they don't land at all, the battle text says IMMUNE, and they add no stack.

drain.description: One stack drains away this many ticks after the last stack was gained or lost, so a party that isn't chaining control sits near zero.

defeatedUnits.description: Knocked-out units stay down between fights until something revives them.

restore.description: After a won fight, every standing member regains these % of its max HP and of its max MP. Absent or 0: nothing restores them between fights (the core set's rule).

premiumChance.description: Chance each offered slot rolls a premium perk, if one is available.

repeatPicked.description: Can a perk already picked this run be offered again?

offerInapplicable.description: Can a perk no party unit can receive be offered?

name.description: Player-facing text. The engine never reads it.

kind.description: amount: takes flat or percent changes. points: already in points or percent; flat changes only.

brings.description: A status the unit holds while the stat is above 0, for behaviour beyond hit resolution, targeting and timing.

cooldown.description: The kind's speed: the base cooldown of its basic attack, in ticks.

hands.description: 2: a two-handed weapon, which empties the offhand.

items.description: An armor type or an offhand kind. A class wears only its own.

name.description: Shown on its icon or sheet line, e.g. BURN.

text.description: Player-facing text. The engine never reads it.

label.description: Drives removal, conditions and the batch its pulses resolve in. marker (step 5i): neither buff nor debuff.

show.description: icon: on the HP bar with its total. sheet: listed on the unit sheet. stat: shown as a stat.

tags.description: Tags that boosts (on its applications' stacks) and damage-taken modifiers (on its pulses) can name.

perSource.description: Per source mode: each source keeps its own copy, using `stacking`.

duration.description: Absent: permanent, until the fight ends.

cap.description: Intensity: the most stacks. `holder` scales read the holder.

live.description: Step 5i: read whenever the holder's stats are worked out, from its other stats as they stand without this change (Thorns from Armor, Guard included), not once at application.

boosts.description: The holder's outgoing damage or healing, by tag. A scale `of: target` reads the unit being hit (Judgement, Brittle).

taken.description: Damage-taken modifiers. No tag: all damage.

absorb.description: Intensity only: soaks damage after mitigation, one stack per point.

block.description: Blocks the next damage above this percent of the holder's max HP, from any source, after mitigation and before absorbs; then the status ends (Aegis).

interrupt.description: A cast in progress that the lockout covers is lost (see ruleset.lostCast).

pause.description: A cast in progress that the lockout covers is held, not lost: its wind-up resumes where it was when the lockout ends.

riders.description: Adds a rider to the holder's hits that carry `on`.

seek.description: The holder's actions carrying this tag (basic, ability or all) have Seek: their first pick ignores Taunt.

strike.description: After each of the holder's basic attacks: one more hit with the weapon's damage, of kind extra, at `to`. Extra strikes don't chain.

chance.description: Percent, rolled on the holder's dice. Default: always.

scale.description: A stat read live whose value is added to `chance` (Double strike).

to.description: The same target, or a rule (Arc: a second, random foe, excluding the target). Step 5i: a rule that picks several units strikes each of them (every other foe).

share.description: Step 5i: percent of the weapon's damage each strike deals. Default 100.

chain.description: Step 5i: each strike that lands rolls `chance` again for one more, at most `times` more after the first, each share % of the one before. It takes the place of a plain strike on the unit that reads the same `scale` stat (Flurry wraps over Double strike), so a swing rolls that chance once. The one bend of "extra strikes don't chain".

pulse.description: A repeating effect. Intensity: its trigger.

do.description: Absent: the pulse is only a timer, for an Intensity drop.

if.description: Step 5i: a pulse whose conditions fail does nothing that beat ("while any foe burns"); an Intensity drop still happens.

kind.description: Action and hit events, and (step 5i) ko, healed and overhealed: the kind of the action or hit behind it.

tags.description: Hit events only: the hit carries at least one of these tags (its kind and type, "crit" when it crits, "area" when its effect is aimed at several units).

notTags.description: Step 5i, hit events only: the hit carries none of these (`area`: a single-target hit).

status.description: Status events, and damage events: the status whose pulse or reaction dealt the damage.

other.description: Step 5i: who the event's other unit is, from the holder's side: holder (a kill it landed, a status it applied, a heal or revive it gave), ally, foe, or any (there is one).

source.description: Step 5i, status events only: the status was applied by the holder (a Mark it gave, an Aegis it gave).

seat.description: Step 5i: the unit the event is about sits in this seat of the party's formation (a position id, or next / previous from the holder's).

amountAtLeast.description: Step 5i: the event's amount is at least this ("a cast that paid MP": 1).

countAtLeast.description: Step 5i, action_resolve only: its hits landed on at least this many units of the other side.

repeat.description: Step 5i, action events only: true matches only a recast's repeat, false only ordinary actions. Default: both.

drop.description: Intensity only: how far the total drops on each trigger.

crit.description: Turns crits on for its pulses, a rare exception. fromSource: statuses that know their source only, the source's crit stats and dice.

notTags.description: Step 5i, hit events only: the hit carries none of these (`area`: a single-target hit).

countAtLeast.description: Step 5i, action_resolve only: its hits landed on at least this many units of the other side.

repeat.description: Step 5i, action events only: true matches only a recast's repeat, false only ordinary actions. Default: both.

actor.description: Who acts. source only for statuses that know their source. Default holder.

if.description: Step 5i: checked when the reaction resolves, every one must hold: a side's state (as an ability's `if`, read from the actor's side) or a test of the event's other unit or owner. When one fails, the reaction does nothing.

unit.description: other: the event's other unit (as `to: other`); owner: the unit the event is about (as `to: owner`).

anyOf.description: Reactions only: the event's other unit, or the unit it's about, passes `where` ("the foe it hit is Sundered", "the ally that took the hit is below half").

unit.description: other: the event's other unit (as `to: other`); owner: the unit the event is about (as `to: owner`).

anyOf.description: Reactions only: the event's other unit, or the unit it's about, passes `where` ("the foe it hit is Sundered", "the ally that took the hit is below half").

focus.description: Step 5i, Marked: the holder's foes' basic attacks pick a holder while one can be picked, by draw among several, under the Taunt rule (Seek follows it past a Taunting foe). Abilities keep their own targeting.

single.description: Step 5i, Marked: each applier keeps one copy: applying it to a unit ends the copy that applier gave anywhere else. Statuses that know their source only.

aim.description: Step 5i: the holder's basic attacks pick by this rule. When it finds nobody, the next in line picks: a Marked foe, then the default.

rule.description: Its Taunt rule is an action's own; an all-pick hits every unit it finds, each hit a basic attack's.

first.description: Ahead of a Marked foe. Without it, a Marked foe comes first.

mods.description: Step 5i: changes to the holder's own abilities, read each time one is used. An Intensity status's changes don't grow with its stacks.

of.description: Absent: every ability the holder has.

ability.description: These abilities by id, each with its trained forms (a mythic naming its class's ability).

does.description: Abilities whose effects do one of these: revive, heal or damage, or apply this status (stun, silence, shield, guard...).

if.description: The holder passes this when the ability is checked and when it pays ("while it holds over half its MP").

mp.description: Percent change to its MP cost: −20 a fifth less, −100 free, +50 half again. Changes add up; the cost never falls below 0.

hp.description: An HP price on top, paid when the ability resolves, with its MP.

pct.description: Percent of the ability's own MP cost (before `mp` changes), paid in HP as the pay effect pays (G12).

share.description: Paid as the same share of max HP as the cost is of max MP, not point for point.

floor.description: The ability waits rather than leave the holder below this percent of its max HP.

cast.description: Its wind-up, in ticks, before cast-time reduction, in place of its own ("winds up in a moment": 1).

stacks.description: Its applications of these statuses (absent: every Intensity status) add pct % more stacks, on top of the applier's boosts.

heal.description: Its heals heal this percent more.

target.description: Its own target rule, in place of the ability's (the Taunt rule applies, unless it has Seek).

seek.description: It has Seek: its first pick ignores Taunt.

wait.description: It also waits for these, as its own `if` does.

apply.description: Statuses its hits apply as well, after its own.

stacks.description: Intensity: stacks added, scaled only as stated here, plus the applier's boosts that name the status or its tags. Default 1.

duration.description: Default: the status's own. 0 only for an instant lockout.

chance.description: Percent, rolled on the applier's dice. Default: guaranteed.

crits.description: Step 5i: crits by condition on the holder's hits.

tag.description: Only hits carrying this tag (basic, ability, extra, physical, magical, area).

when.description: Only hits on a unit that passes this, read as the hit lands.

chance.description: Points added to the hit's crit chance, after every stat change (100: it always crits, whatever else holds, Gambler's coin included).

bonus.description: Percent more crit bonus, the part of the crit multiplier above ×1: 100 makes ×1.5 into ×2.

echo.description: Step 5i: the holder's extra strikes are heard as basic attacks by its statuses' reactions and triggers that name kind basic, unless that status also names kind extra for the same event, or gives strikes itself. Boosts still see them as extra.

set.description: Step 5i: after every other change, the holder's stat is this value while it holds the status.

cover.description: Step 5i: when a hit on another living ally would deal it more than share % of its max HP, after its mitigation and before its block and absorbs, the holder takes the whole hit instead: it resolves again against the holder, statuses and riders included, keeping its crit and without a second dodge. A hit moves once.

floor.description: Step 5i: the holder's HP can't fall below 1 while it holds this: a blow that would knock it out leaves it at 1, and nothing falls.

spend.description: The status ends (cause spent) the first time it holds a blow.

heals.description: Step 5i: only its own heals land on the holder (its abilities, its Lifesteal, its statuses' reactions); heals from others, a Regen they gave included, restore nothing.

revives.description: Step 5i: every revive the holder makes, from its abilities and its statuses' reactions alike (Einherjar).

ready.description: true: every action ready; false: every action on cooldown. It wins over the revive's own `ready`, and false wins over true.

hp.description: The HP they come back with, in place of the revive's (target is the revived unit).

supplies.description: Step 5h round 6: supplies in the bag at the start.

benchMp.description: Step 5h: share of max MP a member regains after each won fight it sat out (from the max it last fought with).

fresh.description: Step 5h: share of its cooldown already run for a fresh ability: a starting unit's, a recruit's, one just learned.

muster.description: Step 5h: the Muster's pick of recruits.

odds.description: Room odds for the other floors, by kind.

lateFrom.description: Elites and campfires only from this floor.

ensure.description: Rooms of a kind an act has at least, where the rules allow.

easyTo.description: Step 5h round 6: the easy pool's last floor (default 2).

campPaths.description: Step 5h round 6: mid-act campfires are added until at least this share of the ways up pass one before the last floor.

ref.description: Step 5h round 6: each pool's reference floor, where its fights' own knobs hold (default 1, 5, 6).

tome.description: Chance, in percent, that an offer is a tome (a member learns an ability) instead of gear.

recruit.description: Chance an offer is a recruit.

supply.description: Chance an offer is a supply.

legendaries.description: How many of the offers are always a legendary piece.

trophy.description: A legendary piece is won outright, on top of the pick.

aimed.description: Step 5h round 6: the first this many offers are pieces aimed at someone in the party.

formations.description: Step 5h round 6: a second pick follows, of this many formations (an elite's).

extra.description: Step 5i: chance, in percent, that a second pick of `count` pieces follows the first (gear only, from the same rarity table): a third more gear for the fourth slot.

mixed.description: Step 5h: chance, in percent, that the pick mixes kinds: one piece of gear, then offers rolled from `mix` (the rest stay gear).

mix.description: Weights of the other kinds in a mixed pick.

sealed.description: Step 5h round 6: a piece whose rarity (rare or better) and name stay hidden until taken.

bundle.description: Step 5h round 6: a common piece and a potion or a tonic together.

tome.description: Chance, in percent, that an offer is a tome (a member learns an ability) instead of gear.

recruit.description: Chance an offer is a recruit.

supply.description: Chance an offer is a supply.

legendaries.description: How many of the offers are always a legendary piece.

trophy.description: A legendary piece is won outright, on top of the pick.

formations.description: Step 5h round 6: a second pick follows, of this many formations (an elite's).

extra.description: Step 5i: chance, in percent, that a second pick of `count` pieces follows the first (gear only, from the same rarity table): a third more gear for the fourth slot.

mixed.description: Step 5h: chance, in percent, that the pick mixes kinds: one piece of gear, then offers rolled from `mix` (the rest stay gear).

mix.description: Weights of the other kinds in a mixed pick.

sealed.description: Step 5h round 6: a piece whose rarity (rare or better) and name stay hidden until taken.

bundle.description: Step 5h round 6: a common piece and a potion or a tonic together.

offRoster.description: Step 5h: share of offered gear (spoils, chests, events; not the shop or a trophy) rolled for classes not in the roster, where there is such a piece.

seat.description: Step 5h: a seat at camp is among the options, while there's one to win.

mythic.description: Step 5i: the acts whose opening boon (the boss's before them) offers a mythic in place of its legendary piece: one for a roster member's class (the party first) that the run doesn't hold, while one is left.

slots.description: Step 5i: an offered piece's slot is rolled first, by these weights; then a class (the roster's, or one off it by `spoils.offRoster`), a kind it wears in that slot, the rarity, and a piece of that kind and rarity. Absent: every slot alike.

lesson.description: Step 5i: members a lesson (a captive's or a stranger's) trains, each once (default 3).

cage.description: Step 5h: chance the chest is a cage: a recruit with a piece suited to it.

camp.description: The share of REST those standing at camp get, whatever the pick (default all).

train.description: Step 5h: members TRAIN teaches or upgrades (default one).

stranger.description: Step 5h: chance a stranger at the fire asks to join.

auto.description: Step 5h round 6: on arrival everyone recovers this (HP and MP, the fallen rise); then one pick, REST (`hp` and `mp` again, everyone) or TRAIN. Without it, the old pick of REST, FOCUS, RAISE or TRAIN.

captive.description: Step 5h round 6: after a won fight with any of `people` in it, a captive this often (never two fights running), taken in at `hp`%, or a lesson.

trainStep.description: A shop's training can be bought again in the same visit, each time this much dearer (learning and upgrading alike); without it, once each a visit.

gear.description: How many pieces of each rarity.

legendaryByAct.description: Step 5h: legendary pieces a visit, by act (in place of gear.legendary).

drops.description: Round 9: offered as a choice of one after every won fight.

bag.description: Supplies carried at most, a slot a kind.

early.description: Step 5h round 6: the climb a floor below a pool's reference floor (default `step`).

knobs.description: Per act, added to each fight's own knob (HP +k %, damage +k/2.5 %): regular fights, the rise per floor from each pool's reference floor, elites, the boss.

shape.description: By tier (fight, elite, boss): HP % and damage % added to every foe on top of the knob, so a tier's fights can be longer and softer at the same cost.

growFrom.description: From this floor, each pack of two or more may gain one more foe.

levelGold.description: A level-up can be taken as this much gold instead.

neverGrow.description: Enemies whose packs never grow (Snakes: their Bleed doesn't shrink with a fight's knob).

name.description: Player-facing text. The engine never reads it.

text.description: Player-facing text. The engine never reads it.

knob.description: The region's own adjustment to its act's knobs.

name.description: Player-facing text. The engine never reads it.

knob.description: Its own knob, set by the rogue calibration: what makes it cost what its tier should.

text.description: Player-facing text. The engine never reads it.

label.description: Player-facing text. The engine never reads it.

text.description: Player-facing text. The engine never reads it.

gold.description: Gold it costs; it can't be picked without.

variants.description: Step 5h: versions of the event; one is rolled on entering, its text and options in place of the first's.

text.description: Player-facing text. The engine never reads it.

label.description: Player-facing text. The engine never reads it.

text.description: Player-facing text. The engine never reads it.

gold.description: Gold it costs; it can't be picked without.

hpBelow.description: HP below this percent of max HP.

mpBelow.description: MP below this share of max MP (step 5g: what a Clarity waits for). A unit with no MP pool never passes.

has.description: Has this status (or every one of these).

lacks.description: Doesn't have this status (or any of these).

buffs.description: true: has any buff. false: has none.

debuffs.description: true: has any debuff. false: has none.

kind.description: Has a status containing this effect kind (narrowed by tag).

stacks.description: A status's Intensity total, in stacks.

atCap.description: Holds this Intensity status at its cap.

belowCap.description: Doesn't hold this Intensity status at its cap (or at all).

casting.description: true: in an action's wind-up right now (step 5f: what Unmake waits for). false: not.

ko.description: true: knocked out, still in the fight. Sides list living units unless a rule asks for this. Default: living.

hasAny.description: Step 5i: has at least one of these statuses (Stunned or Silenced).

lower.description: Step 5i: this stat is lower than the reading unit's: the acting unit in an action, a reaction's actor, a pulse's holder (an ally with less Armor than the wearer).

acted.description: Step 5i: true once one of its actions has resolved this fight; false until then (a unit summoned mid-fight starts false).

top.description: Step 5i: no living unit on its side has more of the highest of these stats ("the foe with the highest Attack or Magic"); ties pass.

weapon.description: Step 5i: wields a weapon of one of these kinds (an enemy's weapon by its kind, if it names one).

hp.description: Current HP, or max HP minus current.

stacks.description: A status's Intensity total, in stacks.

when.description: 1 if the condition holds for the unit read (`of`), else 0: scaling from a condition instead of a stat.

count.description: Step 5i: a count, as COUNTS says: the unit's buffs or debuffs, an action's targets or the units its hits landed on, or the units on a side that pass a test.

times.description: Multiplies the term by a stat, read live: "X% per point of Y" (Lifesteal, Siphon).

ifNone.description: When `where` leaves nobody, use the whole side instead ("if every foe is Taunting, any foe").

exclude.description: targets: skip the action's chosen targets ("a second, random foe", "up to three other foes"). Step 5i, reactions only: other or owner, skip the event's other unit or the unit it's about ("every other foe", "a random foe other than the one it hit").

seat.description: Step 5i: the unit in this seat of the party's formation (a position id), or `next` / `previous`: the seat after or before the reading unit's, by slot order, wrapping round and skipping empty seats.

anyOf.description: swing (step 5i): the basic attack's interval now, its cooldown after Attack speed; highest is the slowest.
The highest of these stats ("the foe with the highest Attack or Magic").

hits.description: Actions only. Each hit resolves in order and reads the state left by the earlier ones.

riders.description: Actions only: extra instances attached to each hit.

apply.description: Actions only: statuses attached to each hit.

stacks.description: Intensity: stacks added, scaled only as stated here, plus the applier's boosts that name the status or its tags. Default 1.

duration.description: Default: the status's own. 0 only for an instant lockout.

chance.description: Percent, rolled on the applier's dice. Default: guaranteed.

oneOf.description: Deals damage. In an action, each hit is a hit; in a pulse or reaction it is not, and fires no hit events.
Restores HP, never above max. Never mitigated.

stacks.description: Intensity: stacks added, scaled only as stated here, plus the applier's boosts that name the status or its tags. Default 1.

duration.description: Default: the status's own. 0 only for an instant lockout.

chance.description: Percent, rolled on the applier's dice. Default: guaranteed.

oneOf.description: Applies a status, by its stacking mode.

label.description: buff or debuff; marker (step 5i) only with `status`, to lift one's own bookkeeping.

order.description: Which go first when fewer than all are removed. Default newest.

move.description: Step 5i: each status removed passes to the acting unit as it was, its stacks and time left with it, unless the actor is immune to it (a buff stolen).

oneOf.description: Removes buffs or debuffs, optionally narrowed to a named status or an effect kind. Unremovable statuses stay, and so do the buffs of a unit with immune:dispel.

hp.description: HP the unit comes back with (`target` is the revived unit).

ready.description: true: every action ready. Default: every action on cooldown, as at the start of a fight. The reviver's `revives` (a status field) wins over this.

after.description: Step 5i: the unit stands this many ticks later instead, if the fight hasn't ended and nothing has raised it meanwhile; the reviver needn't be standing then ("stands up a few ticks later").

oneOf.description: Raises a knocked-out unit, one knocked out in an earlier fight included. Its targets must ask for `ko: true`.

set.description: What happens to them, as COOLDOWN_SET says.

oneOf.description: Step 5i: changes the cooldown left on a unit's basic attack or abilities: ready now, a full cooldown, some ticks closer, a share of what's left, or at most a share of its full one. A wind-up already under way carries on.

Step 5i: a price in HP (G12): lost at once, not damage, so no Shield soaks it, no Armor cuts it and nothing reacts to it; it never takes the payer below 1 HP. An ability's HP price is this effect on itself, after whatever reads its HP first.

share.description: Percent of the damage it's sized from. Default 100.

of.description: weapon (the default): the actor's basic attack against each target, its damage with the weapon's riders and statuses, as an extra strike's. hit: the raw amount of the hit that set the reaction off (before Armor or Magic resist), in that hit's damage type.

oneOf.description: Step 5i, reactions only: a hit of kind extra by the actor at each target (the dodge's riposte, the blow returned for an ally). It can crit and be dodged, meets Armor or Magic resist, and fires hit events; it never brings extra strikes of its own.

stacks.description: Intensity: stacks added, scaled only as stated here, plus the applier's boosts that name the status or its tags. Default 1.

duration.description: Default: the status's own. 0 only for an instant lockout.

chance.description: Percent, rolled on the applier's dice. Default: guaranteed.

of.description: The statuses to pick from, each with its own stacks.

oneOf.description: Step 5i: applies one of these statuses, picked at random on the actor's dice.

Step 5i, reactions to the holder's own action_resolve only: the action that set it off resolves again at once, with no wind-up and no MP, choosing its targets afresh by its own rule, its cooldown untouched. The repeat fires its own action events, which `repeat: false` filters skip.
Brings new units into the fight on the actor's side, up to ruleset.maxEnemies living units on that side. They enter with every action on cooldown.
Each target leaves the fight (not a knockout: its statuses end, nothing reacts to a KO) and `count` new units take its place, up to the cap.

atLeast.description: At least this many pass. Default 1, or 0 when atMost is given.

atMost.description: Step 5i: at most this many pass (0: none does, "no foe is Marked").

seat.description: Step 5i: the unit in this seat of the party's formation (a position id), or `next` / `previous`: the seat after or before the reading unit's, by slot order, wrapping round and skipping empty seats.

healer.description: Step 5h round 6: a class that heals or raises others.

from.description: Step 5h round 6: the rarities a piece can be tempered from (default common, uncommon). Step 5i: a piece becomes a piece of the next rarity of its slot and kind that its wearer can wear (a rare one a legendary).

risk.description: Step 5h round 6: chance the piece cracks and is lost instead.

anyOf.description: Step 5h round 6: every fallen member rises at this share of HP.
Step 5i: n members (three, as every training opportunity) each take one training: learn an ability, or an ability's or the passive's power step or version.

gear.description: Step 5h round 6: each carries a piece of this rarity suited to it.
